spanish: En el día del mes el primero, en el uno al mes, levantarás el tabernáculo de la tienda de reunión.

findings.issue: אֶחָד is an anarthrous cardinal; “el” in “el uno” is article smoothing so the cardinal can stand as a noun.
מוֹעֵד is absolute and anarthrous, so the construct chain is not marked definite; “el tabernáculo” and “la tienda” add Spanish definiteness.

notes: The two date phrases, hiphil 2ms levantarás, the object marker left untranslated, and the construct chain otherwise match the tokens.
